sources.title: Youssofal/Qwen3.8-27B-MTPLX-Optimized-Speed-FP16 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: The FP16 precision sibling of Qwen 3.8 27B Optimized Speed. M1 and M2 Macs do not run bf16 well, so this build keeps every quantized weight byte-identical to the parent and stores the remaining floating tensors (scales, biases, norms, the GDN convolution and state parameters, and the MTP head) in fp16 instead of bf16.

sources.snippet: Overview Qwen3.8-27B-MTPLX-Optimized-Speed is a 4-bit quantized version of Qwen 3.8 27B optimized for Apple Silicon Macs, built and maintained by Youssofal. The model retains the original multi-token-prediction (MTP) head, enabling MTPLX's speculative decoding to draft multiple tokens ahead and verify them in a single pass, delivering 2-3x speedup compared to standard inference. sources.snippet: Recommended for coding: Qwen 3.6 27B Optimized Speed V2 is a dynamic 4-bit hybrid with hand-tuned sensitive parts kept at up to 16-bit. It is much higher quality than the original Optimized Speed model and faster on long agent tasks. It is slightly larger and a little slower for short chats.
